items.source: Sets the cursor to return all data returned by the query at once rather than splitting the results into batches.
items.translation: 将游标设置为一次性返回查询的所有结果，而不是将结果拆分为批次。

items.source: Prevents the server from timing out idle cursors.
items.translation: 防止服务器因空闲游标而超时。

items.source:
Sets the cursor to return partial data from a query against a sharded cluster in which some shards do not respond
rather than throwing an error.
items.translation: 将游标设置为从分片集群返回部分查询数据，即使某些分片未响应也不会抛出错误。

items.source: Meta.CursorOption represents OP_QUERY wire protocol flags to change the behavior of queries.
items.translation: Meta.CursorOption 表示用于更改查询行为的 OP_QUERY 线协议标志。

items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）
